limitations: The first live pass ended partial because 10 proposed figures/plans failed validation; 24 valid Meta-authored bank widgets were displayed.

Automatic correction of rejected plans was implemented after observing these failures and tested without provider calls. This report does not claim a second live whole-paper run with the repair patch.
